LanguageData.GravshipFleetPro_Setting_NeedsFleet: These settings belong to the fleet half, which needs Gravship Fleet. While it is not active, the fleet half is off and the settings below do nothing.
LanguageData.GravshipFleetPro_Setting_RetainMap: Keep the map while another grav engine remains
LanguageData.GravshipFleetPro_Setting_RetainMapDesc: Turn this off for vanilla behavior: launching a gravship abandons the current map, and everyone and everything left on it is lost.
LanguageData.GravshipFleetPro_Setting_CollapseDelayDe: How long the thick mountain roof stands before it collapses into rock. Set to 0 to collapse the moment takeoff ends.
LanguageData.GravshipFleetPro_MapRetained: Another grav engine's field pinned the ground: the map is kept, and the launch site collapsed.
